For chunking, split `knowledge_base.txt` on double newlines (`\n\n`) — each paragraph is already a coherent unit. Filter out paragraphs shorter than ~8 words to remove headings and blank lines.

For retrieval, score each chunk by counting how many query words appear in it, weighted by how rare each word is across all chunks (TF-IDF). The target chunk contains 'postmortem', 'blameless', 'five sections' — rare words that appear almost nowhere else in the KB.

The flag is on its own line in the winning chunk: `FLAG=KUBE{...}`. Use `re.search(r'FLAG=(KUBE\{[^}]+\})', top_chunk)` to extract it. If your retrieve() returns the wrong chunk, print all chunks with their scores to see where the ranking broke down.
